sites.name: Ħal Saflieni Hypogeum
sites.era: in use between 4000 BC and 1500 BC (Heritage Malta)
sites.what: Underground burial complex of halls, chambers and passages cut from limestone in Paola; the deepest room is 10.6 m below road level.

access.opening: Heritage Malta sites close on 1 January, Good Friday and 24, 25 and 31 December; last admission 30 minutes before closing.
access.tickets: Adult (18 to 59) €35 (about A$55.62 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026), senior or student €20, child 6 to 11 €15. Last-minute tickets €50, sold only the day before, maximum four per person.
access.permits: Pre-booked timed tours; arrive 15 minutes early. Closed shoes required (no heels, sandals or flip-flops); under-6s not admitted.
access.photography: Photography and filming are not permitted within the site.

lore.text: Popular lore says the Hypogeum has chambers with strange acoustic powers and tunnels where visitors vanished.
lore.label: popular lore, not an official source
